paragraphs: Builterra is a civil engineering software provider that sells construction contract administration software, and it was founded in 2014. Its buyers are public and private civil infrastructure teams.

The platform runs the whole workflow, from design quantity take-offs and cost estimating through bid preparation, analysis, and processing, then field inspection reporting and progress payment certification. Take-offs and real-time cost estimates can be produced inside CAD or in a bid preparation portal, priced against historic figures. In the field, the app connects to the bid and captures construction progress and photos, all geo-located. Monthly payment certificates are generated from that data.

The company names AECOM, WSP, Stantec, Parsons, SNC Lavalin, and Defense Construction Canada among its clients, along with large municipalities across Canada and the United States. It was started by Jeff Lyons and Chris Stebbing. The company reports more than five billion dollars in progress payment certificates processed. It also reports over a million inspection photos documented and mapped.
